title: /project-management loads without error for a project-admin user
preconditions: Logged in as a user holding project.admin or at least one per-project admin ProjectRole
expectedResult: Page renders the dashboard stats row, search/filter bar, and project table without a console error or an infinite spinner; PermissionGate does not block access.

title: Creating a minimal project (name only) succeeds
steps: Enter only a Project Name, leave everything else at its default
expectedResult: Modal closes without error and the new project appears in the list with status 'Planning' and priority 'Medium' (the form defaults), projectCode auto-assigned.

title: Project detail page loads for an existing project ID
steps: From the project list, click the 'View Details' (eye) icon on any project row
expectedResult: /project-management/[id] loads showing the project's name, status/priority badges, budget progress, and team card, with no error state.

title: Dashboard stats cards render gracefully for a fresh org with zero projects
preconditions: A brand-new organization with no projects created yet
steps: Log in as this org's admin and navigate to /project-management
expectedResult: No JavaScript error is thrown despite dashboard.totalStats[0] being undefined; stats cards show 0 / $0 rather than crashing, and (if the user holds project.create) a default 'Default' project is auto-created per the fetchProjects auto-provision logic.

title: ProjectSelector renders in the Navbar and lists at least one project after first login
preconditions: User belongs to at least one project
steps: Log in and observe the ProjectSelector control in the Navbar/Sidebar
expectedResult: ProjectSelector shows the project name and code for the currently selected project (defaulting to a project the user administers, if any) rather than a blank or perpetually-loading control.
